'''Klide''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], who worked as a research scientist on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Klide was educated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core worlds]] and studied a combination of [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeology]] and cryptography. He arrived on Cularin in about [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], to study a mural in [[Jax Warehouse]]. He was off-world when the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] [[Cularin's disappearance|disappeared]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and he returned to Cularin after it reappeared in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He continued to study the mural and following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], became acquainted with [[Lora Nadad]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was hiding out in the warehouse.

Eventually Klide figured out the meaning of the mural, realizing that it gave the co-ordinates for the location of an ancient artifact, the [[Eye of the Sun]]. However, shortly afterwards, he was approached by [[Len Markus]], who took Klide's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], which contained details of all of his research.
